newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares at record levels in late IBIS trade.
newsitem.headline: German shares at record levels in late IBIS trade.

text.p: 1447 GMT - German shares rise strongly in late electronic trade on Friday, but rise slows slightly before the weekend. A one percent rise on the Dow Jones Industrial index the main factor behind German share strength, but Dow Jones index loses some impetus as trade continues. Dollar strength also helps boost sentiment.
* IBIS DAX index at 3,753.05 points, up 15.89 points.
* June DAX future contract at 3,752 points, up 14.5.
* SGL Carbon remains among leading gainers, recovering after U.S. and EU authorities said last week SGL being probed on price-fixing allegations.
